purpose: Freeze Python-era semantic expectations while the unified Rust CLI replaces the legacy entry points. Arguments are intentionally the new Rust surface; parity is semantic, not command-name or flag-layout compatibility.

command_cases.name: successful deterministic introspection
command_cases.python_oracle: Legacy describe/version-style commands returned machine-readable tool and asset identity without changing data.

command_cases.name: native ruleset selection preserves the frozen catalog semantics
command_cases.python_oracle: The Python runtime_rulesets oracle resolves process-authoring/strict to a non-empty, schema-valid ordered rule set containing both warning and blocker severities.

command_cases.name: native release validation preserves the frozen gate semantics
command_cases.python_oracle: The Python release oracle treated a structurally empty package as a complete validation run while keeping release control distinct from malformed invocation.

command_cases.name: malformed invocation
command_cases.python_oracle: Malformed command input exits non-zero and prints actionable usage guidance.

contract_cases.name: completed validation with data warnings
contract_cases.python_oracle: Legacy validation distinguished completed data findings from protocol or runtime failure.
